'''Baker droids'''<ref name="Evil Plans EG">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode308.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Evil Plans}}</ref> were a model of [[Cooking droid/Legends|cooking droid]] built using the frames of [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droids]] that catered social events. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Unidentified baker droid/Legends|one baker droid]] assisted [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] with a gathering held for Senator [[Aang/Legends|Aang]].<ref name="Evil Plans" />
